rules.description: User is considered watching a repo only if watch mode is Normal or Auto (not None or Dont)
rules.action: Return true indicating user is watching

rules.description: User cannot watch a repo if they are blocked by the repo owner
When unwatching, if current mode is WatchModeAuto, transition to WatchModeDont instead of WatchModeNone
rules.action: Set mode to WatchModeDont to prevent auto-rewatch

rules.description: Auto-watch mode is not overridden if user already has explicit watch or dont-watch
Repository num_watches counter is updated when watch mode transitions between watchable and non-watchable states
Package access mode is determined by owner type (org vs user) and doer relationship
rules.condition: Owner is org: check team permissions; Owner is user: check if doer is owner or visibility is public/limited
rules.action: Set access mode from None to Owner based on relationship

rules.description: Package listing filters out internal packages by default
rules.action: Only non-internal packages are returned in API results

rules.description: Package deletion uses deferred blob cleanup - blobs are not deleted immediately from storage
rules.action: Only DB records are deleted; blob files are cleaned up by cleanup_packages cron task
rules.code_snippet: // HINT: PACKAGE-DEFER-STORAGE-DELETE: Blobs are not deleted immediately
